summary: Default-off registration policy and owner approval foundation completed in PR24; all final CI checks passed, awaiting review.

Registration disabled and approval required by default. Every signup creates only a viewer with no module grants or authenticated session. Pending accounts remain inactive; ordinary role/status editing refuses pending markers; dedicated owner approval activates viewer only.

Owner policy and approval writes recheck active owner permission and valid session under existing bootstrap mutex. Policy revision prevents stale updates. Signup reuses trusted origin/CSRF, DB rate buckets and bounded Argon2 hashing slots, checks policy again after hashing, consumes anonymous context and returns generic duplicate acknowledgement.

Registration request bodies bounded to 4096 bytes with generic validation errors. No public account-status lookup, email verification, password recovery, rejection/deletion or automatic login.

Documented security/schema design in docs/REGISTRATION.md. Migration 0006 adds disabled policy singleton and approval markers without rewriting users; downgrade refuses unresolved pending registrations to prevent approval bypass. Missing approval table safely blocks generic user role/status edits; health readiness does not prove schema readiness.

Vue3 JavaScript adds public registration form plus independent owner policy and paginated approval components. Password native input cleared on submit/unmount, requests cancelled on cleanup, permission changes remove controls. No architecture or dependency migration.
